title: Student Testimonials
subtitle: Real experiences from learners who transformed their careers with SPEDICS.

items.name: Priya Raman
items.quote: The practical sessions and trainer support helped me confidently step into my first preschool role. SPEDICS made learning engaging and career-focused.

items.name: Anitha Krishnan
items.quote: As a homemaker returning to work, I found the online mode perfect. The modules on child development changed how I support children every day.

items.name: Meera Joshi
items.quote: Excellent structured curriculum with hands-on phonics activities. I now run my own reading enrichment sessions for young learners.

items.name: Kavitha Sundaram
items.quote: The inclusive education modules were eye-opening. Supportive faculty and practical IEP training prepared me for real classroom challenges.

items.name: Deepa Menon
items.quote: I opened my own preschool after completing this programme. The school setup and admissions modules were incredibly practical.

items.name: Ramesh Varma
items.quote: My confidence in English communication improved dramatically. Great for teachers who want to excel in international school environments.
